The '''2015–16 Southeast Missouri State Redhawks men's basketball team''' represented [[Southeast Missouri State University]] during the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Redhawks, led by first year head coach [[Rick Ray (basketball)|Rick Ray]], played their home games at the [[Show Me Center]] and were members of the West Division of the [[Ohio Valley Conference]]. They finished the season 5–24, 2–14 in OVC play to finish in last place in the West Division. They failed to qualify for the [[2016 Ohio Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|OVC tournament]].
